The '''Cularin Judicial Branch''' was a judicial organization based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. They were based in the [[Gadrin Judicial Center]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and [[Echari Di'San]] was put on trial by them, after he was implicated in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Rysko Barnt]].
